title: ALLOWANCE — An allowance, not your wallet
voiceInstructions: You are presenting a product you built, on stage, to a quiet room. Calm, warm and confident; unhurried, about 130 words per minute. A soft smile in the voice. Let commas and ellipses breathe. Land the last word of each sentence slightly lower and slower. Never salesy, never excited, never rushed. Clear, neutral English.

lines.tts: I asked my AI agent for one monitor arm.
lines.caption: I asked my AI agent for one monitor arm.

lines.tts: A product page told it to buy three parts instead.
lines.caption: A product page told it to buy three parts instead.

lines.tts: So it did.
lines.caption: So it did.

lines.tts: It never asked me.

lines.caption: And today, the only way to let one pay is to hand it your wallet.

lines.caption: Every limit you'd want lives in a prompt — and a prompt can be talked out of anything.

lines.caption: So I built ALLOWANCE.

lines.tts: Give your AI agent an allowance... not your wallet.
lines.caption: Give your AI agent an allowance — not your wallet.

lines.tts: Two hundred dollars a month.
